verdict.rationale: ELSTER is a government tax-filing portal and transmission rail (online tax office, certificates, receipt upload, the MeinELSTER+ app). It is not an AI agent or LLM host, so acting as an MCP client that plugs in external tool servers is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows any agent or assistant component that could consume MCP tools, so the axis does not flip to applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
